title: AnchorPrompt: Self-Distilled Soft Prompts for Robust Audio-Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.00706v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large audio-language models (LALMs) are sensitive to input perturbations, such as noise, waveform corruption, and adversarial injections. We propose AnchorPrompt, an efficient adaptation method that keeps the model frozen and learns a single block of prompt vectors inserted at the decoder input, between the audio and question embeddings. We train these vectors through self-distillation over diverse audio and text perturbations. To improve answer consistency and mitigate hallucination, we use the model's prediction on the clean recording as the target for answerable inputs, and assign a refusal target when the audio lacks sufficient evidence to answer. Furthermore, AnchorPrompt is perturbation-agnostic at inference, requiring no prior detection of perturbations and enabling zero-shot transfer to unseen distortions. translated_title: AnchorPrompt：面向鲁棒音频-语言模型的自蒸馏软提示
translated_abstract: 大型音频-语言模型对输入扰动（如噪声、波形损坏和对抗性注入）较为敏感。我们提出了AnchorPrompt，这是一种高效的适配方法，它保持模型参数冻结，仅学习插入在解码器输入处、音频嵌入与问题嵌入之间的一组提示向量。我们通过在多种音频和文本扰动上进行自蒸馏来训练这些向量。为了提高答案一致性并缓解幻觉，对于可回答的输入，我们使用模型对干净录音的预测作为蒸馏目标；当音频缺乏足以回答的证据时，则分配拒绝目标。此外，AnchorPrompt在推理阶段与扰动类型无关，无需预先检测扰动，并能够零样本迁移到未见过的失真。我们在三个基准上评估了三个大型音频-语言模型，结果表明AnchorPrompt在大多数测试条件下提高了答案一致性。
tldr: AnchorPrompt通过在冻结的音频-语言模型解码器输入处插入经自蒸馏训练的软提示向量，显著提升了模型在噪声、波形损坏及对抗性扰动下的答案一致性并缓解幻觉，且推理时无需扰动检测，可零样本泛化到未见过的失真。
en_tdlr: AnchorPrompt learns self-distilled soft prompt vectors inserted between audio and question embeddings in frozen audio-language models, improving answer consistency and mitigating hallucinations under diverse perturbations, while remaining perturbation-agnostic and enabling zero-shot transfer to unseen distortions.
